turnos.pregunta: Two-storey stairwell, old paper on it, probably needs removing first.
consultas: Two-storey stairwell, old paper on it, probably needs removing first.
turnos.respuesta:
Old paper is the one part nobody can price from a description — strippable modern paper can come off in whole lengths, while painted-over or older layers can take the surface with them and leave repair work that wasn't visible before. That's usually why it gets looked at in person.

If you'd like someone to take a look when you're ready, I can pass your details along — otherwise feel free to keep browsing.
